mapper.select: SELECT id, tree_code, name, species, age, height, latitude, longitude, `desc`, is_delete, create_time, update_time FROM tree WHERE is_delete = 0 ORDER BY tree_code

SELECT id, tree_code, name, species, age, height, latitude, longitude, `desc`, is_delete, create_time, update_time FROM tree WHERE is_delete = 0 AND (species LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
SELECT id, tree_code, name, species, age, height, latitude, longitude, `desc`, is_delete, create_time, update_time FROM tree WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = 0
SELECT id, tree_code, name, species, age, height, latitude, longitude, `desc`, is_delete, create_time, update_time FROM tree WHERE tree_code = #{treeCode} AND is_delete = 0
